notes: The badass build: the full Simple Survival channel inside the app, newest first, new videos appearing automatically. Six new field chapters (Survival Mindset, Finding Your Way, Signaling and Rescue, Field First Aid, Food: Plants Traps and Fishing, Quick Tips) built on the US Army survival manual structure, hyperlinked contents in every chapter, tap-to-jump cross links between chapters, step by step diagrams for every visual skill including the new deadfall, snare, solar still, shelter and splint builds, and favorites for videos. Same offline guides, bookmarks and checklists carry over.
